title: Nuevo Laredo Invites Families to Hunting and Fishing Parade Sunday

content:
Nuevo Laredo is inviting families to the Desfile Cinegético de Caza y Pesca 2026, a hunting and fishing parade set for this Sunday, Nov. 22, to celebrate the border region's traditions.

The event will bring together hunting and fishing associations and clubs, with backing from the Asociación Nacional de Ganaderos Diversificados (ANGADI), to highlight the activities and customs tied to the region's identity.

Participants will gather at 2 p.m. at the Explanada Independencia, at Doctor Mier and Galeana. The parade begins at 4 p.m. and will end at the Palapas del CIITEV, near the Canchas de Tochito.

The municipal government said the parade aims to preserve regional traditions, strengthen a sense of belonging and give families a day together. The invitation is open to everyone.

The celebration comes as hunting season is underway — an activity city officials have previously estimated at about $20 million in economic impact for the region.

Sources:

  • CML Noticias, Nov. 20, 2026
